name: express-app

scripts.model: node -e "Promise.all([import('fs'), import('chalk')]).then(([{writeFileSync,mkdirSync},{default:chalk}]) => { const name = process.argv[1]; if (!name) { console.error('Usage: npm run model -- TestModel'); process.exit(1); } const base = name.replace(/Model$/i, '').replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').toLowerCase(); const file = base + '.model.js'; mkdirSync('./models', {recursive:true}); writeFileSync('./models/' + file, '// ' + name + ' model\n'); console.log(chalk.blue('Model Created At: ./models/' + file)); })"
